about_the_game:
Welcome to Ethernia, a free 2D MMORPG with pixel art, real-time combat, gathering, crafting, and an engaging narrative inspired by an ancient lost book.

🌍 Open World Full of Secrets

Explore unique regions, face legendary creatures, and unlock ancient powers while interacting with other players in real time.

🧙‍♀️ Choose Your Journey

Create your character, customize attributes and specializations, participate in PvE and PvP events, gather resources, and evolve your build.

📜 Quests, Exploration, and Progression System

From the very first steps, you'll be part of a living story—filled with quests, daily challenges, bosses, and decisions that shape your path.

✨ Highlights:

  • Fantasy pixel art MMORPG

  • PvE, PvP, and class-based progression

  • Gathering, mining, and crafting system

  • Active combat with skills and strategies

  • Deep narrative with multiple branches

  • Completely free to play

Prepare to immerse yourself in our universe, where each player is a living page of history and discover if you are the Heir of Ethernia.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) or Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: integrated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated or High Definition Audio
